titulo: What really happens if you don't use airplane mode ✈️
descripcion: It won't crash the plane. But phones searching for towers can cause a buzzing interference in pilots' headsets, and rules haven't changed yet.

escenas.texto: Have you ever forgotten to turn on airplane mode? Spoiler: the plane did not fall out of the sky.
At thirty thousand feet, your phone can't find a tower, so it keeps shouting louder and louder, at maximum power.
That signal can leak into the pilots' headsets as a buzzing noise, right when they're talking to air traffic control.
One phone is just annoying. Two hundred phones doing it on approach is a real distraction.
That's why airlines still ask for it, even though Wi-Fi on board is allowed.
So it won't crash the plane. It just makes the pilots' job harder. Turn it on. Follow for more.
